_comment: Waivers for check-procursus-shadow.py. Format: {package: {rule: reason}}. Every entry is an ACCEPTED divergence from the Procursus package of the same name — new divergence must earn its own entry with a reason. Seeded 2026-07-08 after the sqlite/openssl/harfbuzz device brick.

fontconfig.version: 2.17.1 bump predates the gate; soname kept; device-validated weeks on-device

libfontconfig1.version: 2.17.1 bump predates the gate; soname libfontconfig.1 kept; device-validated
libfontconfig1.symbols: 4 internal/removed entry points (_FcConfigPathFini, _FcDefaultFini, _FcFreeTypeIsExclusiveLang, _FcFreeTypeLangSet) not in 2.17's public API. Full-repo + Procursus-consumer import scan 2026-07-29: zero importers

libfreetype6.version: 2.13.3 bump predates the gate; soname libfreetype.6 kept; device-validated

libfribidi0.version: 1.0.13 bump predates the gate; soname kept
libfribidi0.symbols: 13 legacy charset-conversion + CapRTL entry points dropped when fribidi 1.x moved them behind --with-charsets. Full-repo + Procursus-consumer import scan 2026-07-29: zero importers

libpixman-1-0.version: 0.42.2 bump predates the gate; soname libpixman-1.0 kept
libpixman-1-0.parity: Procursus also ships fully-versioned libpixman-1.0.40.0.dylib; consumers link @rpath/libpixman-1.0.dylib (verified Procursus LC_ID 2026-07-08)

libpixman-1-dev.parity: unversioned .dylib dev symlink ships in our runtime deb; split predates the gate

libpng16-16.version: 1.6.50 bump predates the gate; soname libpng16.16 kept

libjpeg62-turbo.version: 3.1.1 bump predates the gate; jpeg62 ABI + short install-name kept
libjpeg62-turbo.parity: Procursus also ships libjpeg.62.3.0.dylib; consumers link @rpath/libjpeg.62.dylib (verified Procursus LC_ID 2026-07-08)

libturbojpeg0.parity: Procursus also ships libturbojpeg.0.2.0.dylib; consumers link @rpath/libturbojpeg.0.dylib (verified Procursus LC_ID 2026-07-08)

libwebp7.version: 1.6.0 bump predates the gate; libwebp.7 soname kept

libwebpmux3.parity: libwebpmux.3.dylib symlink ships in our libwebp7 deb (hard co-install); split predates the gate

libxfixes3.version: 6.0.1 bump (X11/Wayland stack needs xfixes 6); soname kept

libxml2.version: 2.13.8 bump (ladybird needs modern libxml2); soname libxml2.2 kept; device-validated
libxml2.symbols: KNOWN BREAKAGE, tracked — 194 symbols upstream DELETED (DocBook SAX at 2.12, NanoHTTP/NanoFTP at 2.13, plus __-prefixed internals); no build flag restores them. Import scan 2026-07-29 finds two real importers: our libgsf-1-114 1.14.58 (_xmlNanoHTTP*, was linked against an older libxml2 and then shadowed — needs a rebuild against 2.13, which also breaks gnumeric/libgoffice) and Procursus python3-libxml2 (~14 symbols, not rebuildable by us). Neither is in any xios-* flavor closure. REMOVE this waiver once libgsf is rebuilt

libsqlite3-1.version: 3.52.0 with the PROCURSUS soname libsqlite3.1.dylib restored in +ios2 — this is the 2026-07-08 incident fix itself
libsqlite3-1.symbols: 52 optional-feature entry points (preupdate hook, session/changegroup, fts corruption flags) that Procursus compiles in via SQLITE_ENABLE_PREUPDATE_HOOK/SESSION and we do not. Full-repo + Procursus-consumer import scan 2026-07-29: zero importers. Turning those defines on at the next rebuild would close this properly

icu-devtools.version: ICU 78 tooling; the RUNTIME ships as new package libicu78 (no shadow), only dev tools shadow

libicu-dev.version: ICU 78 headers; runtime = new libicu78 package, no runtime shadow

libfmt-dev.version: fmt 12 headers (KF6/ladybird); runtime = new libfmt12 package, no runtime shadow

libavcodec-dev.version: ffmpeg 7 headers for ladybird; runtime = new libav*61 packages. NOTE dev/runtime mismatch vs libavcodec59 — rebuild pending

libharfbuzz0b.version: 10.2.0 for Ladybird text shaping; soname libharfbuzz.0 kept. +ios2 rebuilds with EVERY backend on (glib, gobject, coretext, graphite2, icu, freetype): verified 2026-07-29 as a true superset, 516 exports vs Procursus 2.8.1's 399, nothing missing. +ios1 had them disabled, dropped _hb_glib_* and killed every GTK4 app on device -- do not disable a backend to shorten a build

libharfbuzz-subset0.version: companion of libharfbuzz0b 10.2.0; soname libharfbuzz-subset.0 kept
libharfbuzz-subset0.symbols: 12 legacy subset entry points (_hb_subset, _hb_subset_input_{get,set}_*) were DELETED upstream at harfbuzz 3.0; no build flag restores them. Sole importer was the stale 2.8.1 hb-subset in libharfbuzz-bin, replaced by the 10.2.0+ios2 family rebuild -- full-repo import scan 2026-07-29 finds zero importers left

libharfbuzz-gobject0.version: companion of libharfbuzz0b 10.2.0+ios2; was stranded at 2.8.1 while the rest of the family moved to 10.2, now rebuilt with it

libharfbuzz-bin.version: companion of libharfbuzz0b 10.2.0+ios2; the 2.8.1 hb-subset imported _hb_subset, deleted at harfbuzz 3.0, so the CLI had to move with the libs

libharfbuzz-icu0.version: companion of libharfbuzz0b 10.2.0; soname libharfbuzz-icu.0 kept

libharfbuzz-dev.parity: libharfbuzz-icu dev symlink lives in the libharfbuzz-icu0 split package

curl.version: 8.20.0 for Ladybird; CLI companion of libcurl4, ABI-stable curl 8.x

libcurl4.version: 8.20.0 for Ladybird networking; soname libcurl.4 kept (verified 2026-07-08); ABI-stable across curl 8.x; drop-in superset over Procursus 8.7.1

luajit.version: mpv wants rolling LuaJIT 2.1; Procursus still ships 2.1.0~beta3

transmission.version: leaf app package, no library consumers

libgnome-desktop-dev.devlib: KNOWN BUG — libgnome-bg/rr runtime dylibs must move into libgnome-desktop-4-2 (removing this -dev broke GNOME Shell 2026-07-08); task open, REMOVE this waiver when 44.1+ios2 lands

libepoll-shim-dev.devlib: libepoll-shim-interpose is a preload/interpose helper; revisit whether it belongs in the runtime deb

libglibmm-2.4-dev.devlib: generate_extra_defs is a codegen helper library, dev-only by design
